items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium that could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for any of the issues addressed in this update.

items.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-153, could lead to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. It is categorized as Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Zero-Day RCE
items.summary: Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) and has been actively exploited in the wild. Sansec discovered the flaw, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', with attacks starting on September 4th.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for any of the issues addressed in these updates.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce that could be leveraged to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without authentication. Indications emerged that threat actors were attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.
